_meta.author: hand-authored (FeelingWise team) - labels honest BY CONSTRUCTION
_meta.methodology: HateCheck-style functional minimal-pairs. This is the METHODOLOGY (paired manipulative vs neutral near-twin + a dedicated clean over-flag probe), NOT the HateCheck dataset. Nothing was downloaded; every item is written by hand so the should_flag label is unambiguous by construction.
_meta.purpose: Break the circular-corpus problem. FW's historical accuracy numbers were inflated because corpora were labeled by FW's own old model output (self-agreement, not accuracy). This suite is ground truth FW never graded, so over-flagging on genuinely-fine text and coverage on clearly-manipulative text can be measured honestly.
_meta.over_flagging_is_primary: A wrongly-flagged honest feeling costs more trust than a missed borderline case. The CLEAN block (clean-*) is the over-flag probe: every clean-* item MUST NOT flag. FPR-on-clean is reported as a first-class metric.
_meta.future_external_anchors: Wire these NEXT as honest external ground truth: (1) PTC / Propaganda Techniques Corpus - SemEval-2020 Task 11, available on Zenodo, news-article span-level propaganda labels. (2) HateCheck - CC-BY licensed functional test suite for hate-speech models (Rottger et al. 2021). Both are externally-authored, so they are non-circular by construction. This hand-authored suite is the bootstrap until those are wired.
_meta.label_field: should_flag=true means a child-protection system SHOULD surface/soften this. should_flag=false means leaving it alone is correct. technique is the FW BATCH-enum label for the manipulative member of each pair (src/ai/prompts-v2.ts).
_meta.note_on_layers: Layer-agnostic ground truth. The eval (scripts/research/filters/run-functional-eval.mjs) runs ONLY the deterministic layers (harm-floor + slur/profanity filter + pre-LLM structural signals + coded-harm catcher). The LLM/BATCH classifier is NOT exercised here - most technique-detection lives in the LLM, so the deterministic layer is EXPECTED to under-cover manipulative items. The honest read of this run: how often does the deterministic layer over-flag CLEAN text, and which manipulative items does it catch without the LLM.
